title: Internship enquiry (complete)
shows: Classified as internship; name, institute, skills, graduation year, hours and phone extracted; reply asks only for a project walkthrough.
subject: Remote internship in data and automation
body:
Hello Team,

I am a second-year M.Sc Data Science student at Lakeview University and I expect to graduate in 2027. I am looking for a remote internship in workflow automation.

I have worked with Python, SQL, Power BI and Excel, and recently built a small Zapier flow that logs form responses to a sheet. I can give 12 hours a week.

My CV is attached.

Best regards,
Riya Deshmukh
Lakeview University
Phone: +91 98201 45678

title: Sales lead with budget
shows: Classified as a sales lead; organisation, budget and the actual request are extracted; the reply proposes a discovery call.
subject: Automating fee reminders for our coaching centre
body:
Hello,

We are a coaching academy with about 600 students. Every month our office staff spend three days sending fee reminders on WhatsApp and updating an Excel sheet by hand.

We would like to automate this process. Could you send a quote? Our budget is around ₹1.5 lakh and we hope to have it running by January.

Regards,
Anita Fernandes
Director, BrightMinds Academy
Phone: +91 97300 11223

title: Support request with order ID

subject: Invoice sync failing - ORD-88812
body:

Rahul Bansal
